name: Moonlight
source:
In this sci-fi mystery visual novel, you play as Alex, a detective haunted by loss and driven by obsession. When a seemingly routine case begins to unravel, you uncover a conspiracy buried deep within Moonlight, the world’s most powerful AI platform. Secrets, sabotage, and seductive distractions lie in wait.

A narrative-driven experience where your choices shape who you trust, who you love, and how far you’ll go for justice. All while cracking jokes, dodging danger, and trading barbs with your partner-in-chaos, Detective Jack.

[From [url=https://bigbatproductions.itch.io/moonlight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部科幻悬疑视觉小说中，你扮演亚历克斯，一名被失落所困扰、被痴迷所驱使的侦探。当一个看似例行公事的案件开始瓦解时，你会发现埋藏在世界上最强大的人工智能平台Moonlight深处的阴谋。秘密、破坏和诱人的干扰正在等待着你。

这是一种叙事驱动的体验，你的选择决定了你信任的人、你爱的人，以及你会为正义走多远。一边和你的搭档杰克侦探开玩笑，一边躲避危险，一边互相讽刺。

[来自[url=https://bigbatproductions.itch.io/moonlight]Itch.io[/url]]
